### Special functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [cluster()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/cluster-function) | yes | Changes the reference of the query to a remote cluster. | Clusters come from .okql-federation.json (guide/cluster.md). |
| [database()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/database-function) | yes | Changes the reference of the query to a specific database within the cluster scope. | Databases are this scope and the aliases of .okql-federation.json; database('*') and wildcards work in union, find and search. |
| [external_table()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/external-table-function) | **no** | References an external table by name. | No external tables: read files with externaldata. |
| [graph()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/graph-function) | yes | The `graph` function is an intrinsic function that enables querying of a persisted graph entity, similar to the `cluster()`, `database()`, `external_table()`, and `table()` functions. | Persistent graph models (.create-or-alter graph_model, .make graph_snapshot). |
| [materialize()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/materialize-function) | yes | Captures the value of a tabular expression for the duration of the query execution so that it can be referenced multiple times by the query without recalculation. |  |
| [materialized_view()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/materialized-view-function) | yes | References the materialized part of a materialized view. | Views are always current, so max_age has nothing to bound. |
| [stored_query_result()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/stored-query-result-function) | **no** | Retrieves a previously created stored query result. | Not supported. |
| [table()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/table-function) | yes | The table() function references a table by providing its name as an expression of type `string`. |  |

## Window functions

7 of 7 supported. They need serialized input (`serialize`, `order by`, `sort`, `top`, ...).

### Window functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [next()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/next-function) | yes | Returns the value of a column in a row that is at some offset following the current row in a serialized row set. |  |
| [prev()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/prev-function) | yes | Returns the value of a specific column in a specified row. |  |
| [row_cumsum()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/row-cumsum-function) | yes | Calculates the cumulative sum of a column in a serialized row set. |  |
| [row_number()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/row-number-function) | yes | Returns the current row's index in a serialized row set. |  |
| [row_rank_dense()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/row-rank-dense-function) | yes | Returns the current row's dense rank in a serialized row set. |  |
| [row_rank_min()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/row-rank-min-function) | yes | Returns the current row's minimal rank in a serialized row set. |  |
| [row_window_session()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/row-window-session-function) | yes | Calculates session start values of a column in a serialized row set. |  |
